sequence.text: {shot} shot; the camera makes one slow, gentle, steady {move} that keeps going for the whole clip but covers only a very short distance, about a thirtieth of the frame width in total; the camera stays at the same height with a fixed lens, never moves closer to anything and never zooms in; it never travels down the hall, aisle, street or path, so the last frame shows almost the same view as the first frame, every object still in frame.
The view through the windows stays like a soft, slightly out-of-focus still photograph of {window}; every window pane keeps exactly the same size and shape; nothing new appears in the window view.

The indoor air is perfectly clean, clear, dry and still, like a sealed warm room: nothing floats, drifts or falls anywhere between the camera and the walls, and every surface in the room stays exactly as it is.
Light snowflakes drift down slowly through the cold air.
Only a few sparse snowflakes drift down very slowly from high above and fade away in the air before they reach anything; they stay few and never hide the scene.

The {people} stay perfectly still in the same pose with their backs to the camera for the whole clip; they never turn their heads, never look back and never show their faces; their bodies, hands and robes keep exactly their shape; their arms stay hidden at their sides and their scarves, hair and robes do not move at all.
Nobody appears anywhere in the scene for the whole clip, not even tiny figures far in the background.

The clip is one single continuous shot with no cuts and no change of view. The {lock} keep their exact shape, number and position; every door stays exactly as open or closed as in the first frame; no new objects, people, hands, faces, text or emblems appear, and nothing morphs or melts.
The {light} stays as bright and warm as the first frame throughout, with the same colors.

fields.deep: true khi cảnh sâu (hành lang, lối giữa sảnh, phố dài, dãy kệ, cầu cạn) hoặc toàn cảnh ngoài trời rộng
fields.window: cảnh thấy qua cửa sổ, tiếng Anh (vd. 'snowy castle towers at night'); "" nếu không thấy cửa sổ
fields.snowfall: true khi cảnh ngoài trời có tuyết đang rơi trong ảnh
fields.indoor_snow: true khi trong nhà có tuyết phép rơi thưa từ trần (sảnh lớn)
fields.still_air: true cho cảnh trong nhà không có tuyết phép
fields.people: "" nếu không có người; có thì tả ngắn tiếng Anh, số nhiều/ít đúng ảnh (vd. 'two students in black robes and scarlet-and-gold scarves sitting in the armchairs')
fields.motion: 2–4 câu tiếng Anh, mỗi câu một thứ chuyển động CÓ TRONG ẢNH và ở đâu (lửa lò sưởi, nến, nến bay lơ lửng tại chỗ, đuốc, khói ống khói, hơi nước tàu, đom đóm, sương, đèn cây…)
fields.extra: 0–2 câu tùy chọn cho ràng buộc đặc biệt (vd. tàu đứng yên trên cầu, nến bay giữ nguyên vị trí)
fields.lock: danh sách vật chính để khóa, tiếng Anh, số nhiều
fields.light: room | hall | street | scene … (chủ ngữ câu ánh sáng)
fields.sound: âm thanh hợp cảnh, tiếng Anh
